text: that illuminated the whole earth. And I saw myself in this dream

ar: أُعِيذُهُ بِاللَّهِ الْوَاحِدِ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ حَاسِدٍ
translit: U'idhuhu bi-Llahil-Wahid min sharri kulli hasid Period. I seek refuge for him in Allah, the One, from the evil of every envious person.

text: saying, 'I seek refuge in Allah, the One, for this boy from every- from the evil of every jealous person.' 'Don't worry, the [[shaytan|شيطان]], no [[jinn|جن]] is going to hurt this boy.'
But [[Aminah|آمنة بنت وهب]], she took her son back. And from that point, the young boy, [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ﷺ, stayed with his birth mother.
So now he is back with his mother. And [[Halimah|حليمة السعدية]] and her husband, they returned back to their lives in the desert with the tribe of [[Banu Sa'd|بني سعد]].
Now [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ is living with [[Aminah|آمنة بنت وهب]], his mother. And he is an orphan. He doesn't have a father. His father had already passed away even before he was born.

And he lived a life of poverty from his childhood. [[Aminah|آمنة بنت وهب]], the mother of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, she was very poor. And [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, living with his mother, he lived a life of poverty.
And some people may wonder, they may ask, [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ﷺ, he was from the most honorable and respected family of the Arabs.

He was the grandson of [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]]. And [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] was the undisputed leader of the [[Quraysh|قُرَيْش]], the most respected man of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]], the most honored man of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]].
And [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ is directly from his family, he is his own grandson.
So why did he live such a life of poverty when he was from such a great and honorable and respected family?
We need to look at what the Arabs considered to be honor, what was honor to them. Honor was the privilege to serve the [[hujjaj|حجاج]]. It was not money.

Money was not what made them consider to be honorable or respected people. It was this honor of serving the pilgrims, the guests of Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]], those people who would come and make [[Hajj|حج]].

So [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] and his family, even though they were the leaders of the [[Quraysh|قُرَيْش]], they were not rich. They were not wealthy at all because they would spend all of their money in service to the [[hujjaj|حجاج]].

So yes, [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] and his sons, they had businesses, they earned money, definitely. But all of that money, it would go in service of the [[hujjaj|حجاج]], service to the pilgrims.

And we mentioned before that [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] was responsible for providing drink and other services to the [[hujjaj|حجاج]]. And the [[hujjaj|حجاج]], they would come from all over the place, and there were many [[hujjaj|حجاج]].

So even though [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] and his family were earning money, they had their businesses and they had their source of income, all of it was going into taking care of the [[hujjaj|حجاج]]. All of it was going into service of the [[hujjaj|حجاج]].

Such to the extent that they would spend all of their money in service of the [[hujjaj|حجاج]], then they would go and borrow more money to take care of the [[hujjaj|حجاج]] because their income was not enough for everyone.

So they would actually borrow money and go into debt to serve the [[hujjaj|حجاج]]. This was the honor for them. So it was not about wealth, it was not about money, it was about this privilege to serve the [[hujjaj|حجاج]]. So that's why [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], he was not rich. His sons, they were not rich. They were poor. And that's why even though [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ was born into the most honorable and respected household of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]], he grew up poor. He grew up poor for this reason.
So he lived with his mother in this state, in a state of poverty until his mother also passed away. And that was when [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ was six years old.

And then he moved into the custody of his grandfather, [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]]. After his mother passed away, after [[Aminah|آمنة بنت وهب]] passed away, [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ went to live with his grandfather, [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], and he was six years old at that time.

Now [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], he loved this boy since his birth. And he said at the time that this boy was born- and we mentioned last week some of the miraculous events that took place when [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ was born- and [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] he said about his grandson, he said:

translit: Wallahi inna li-ibni hadha la-sha'nan Period. By Allah, surely this son of mine has a great status.

text: 'Surely this boy of mine is something special, and there is something special for him in the future.'
So [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] had this love for his grandson, [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ﷺ, from his birth. So now, at the age of six, he came to live with his grandfather.

And [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] at this time had nine sons of his own. He had ten sons as we mentioned before, but one of those sons, that's the father of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, [[Abdullah ibn Abdul Muttalib|عبد الله بن عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], he had passed away. So he had nine remaining sons. And now he had his grandson, [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ﷺ, as well.

Now as we mentioned, [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] was the most respected man of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]], the leader of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]], the head of [[Quraysh|قُرَيْش]]. So he was honored and respected by all of the people, and he was shown respect, the utmost respect, even by his own children, his own sons.
So [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], he had a special mattress that his sons would keep in front of the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] for [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] to sit on this mattress.

And when he received any type of delegations, or when some other tribal leaders needed to come and discuss something with him or negotiate something with him, they would come and they would meet him on that mattress.

But the sons of [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], out of respect for their father, they would not sit on that mattress. Rather they would just stand around that mattress. And they would not even sit down until their father would come. And when their father would sit down on that mattress, then the sons of [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] would sit down around the mattress. They would not sit on the mattress.

So they would remain standing until their father came. When their father came and sat down on the mattress, the sons, the nine sons, they would sit around the mattress. This was the respect that they showed for their father, [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]].
But [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ﷺ, this young boy, he would slip between his uncles, the sons of [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], and he would go and sit on that mattress.

And his uncles, the sons of [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], they would try to take him out. They would say, 'No, no, you can't sit there. This is for [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]]. We can't sit here.' And they would try to take [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ﷺ and bring him back.
But [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] himself would stop them from touching him. And he would say to his sons, 'Leave this boy. Leave him. Let him sit there.'

translit: Wallahi inna li-ibni hadha la-sha'nan Period. By Allah, surely this son of mine has a great status.

text: 'Let him sit here. Surely this boy of mine, he has something amazing in his future.'
So this was the love that he showed for [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, his grandson, even more than he showed for his own children.

And there is some [[hikmah|حكمة]] from Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] in this as well. [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ﷺ, from the age of six to eight, this age, it's an age where children pick up everything.

And it's an age where they are able to learn, and what they learn at this age, it stays with them throughout their life. And we know that even from people who memorize the Qur'an, for example. Those people who learn it at this age, around six to eight, usually their memory of the Qur'an is much stronger than people who memorize the Qur'an later in their life.
Things that you remember, and things that you witness, and things that you see, and things that you learn at this period in time, from around age six to eight, it sticks with you strongly.
So [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ﷺ, at this age where he's grasping everything, he was sitting with the leader of the [[Quraysh|قُرَيْش]] on his mattress.

Sitting with him, with his grandfather, while his grandfather was receiving this VIP and this tribal chief and this leader, and they were sitting with him discussing, negotiating, talking about important things.
And [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ﷺ, this little boy, he's witnessing all of this and he's taking it all in. So he's learning about leadership.

He is learning the skills of how to speak to people from such a young age. And this is from the [[hikmah|حكمة]] of Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] as well. Everything from the life of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, from his birth up to his passing away, everything that Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] decreed in his life was from the [[hikmah|حكمة]] of Allah.
